Proverbs 18:10 (KJV)
"The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe."
One quiet moment with the Word before the day begins. One short step is enough.

— A gentle doorway into the day

Plain words: The Lord’s name is a safe place you can run to.

Today: Before the day presses in, His name is a place of safety.

So do this: Whisper His name once, slowly, and let it settle.

A simple coloring moment for little ones

When it fits the morning, draw a tall tower with the sun rising behind it. Write the verse in big letters at the bottom. Talk together about how God keeps us safe like a strong tower.
